description: This file defines a FileLoggerProvider class implementing ILoggerProvider for logging to a file, along with extension methods to add this provider to an ILoggingBuilder. It facilitates file-based logging within the Orleans testing host framework.

classes.name: FileLoggerProvider
classes.description: Provides logging output to a specified log file, implementing ILoggerProvider.

classes.name: FileLoggerProviderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for ILoggingBuilder to add FileLoggerProvider.

methods.name: FileLoggerProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a log file path.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates a new FileLogger for a given category.

methods.name: AddFile
methods.description: Extension method to add FileLoggerProvider to an ILoggingBuilder.
